banner.headline: We don't track you by default.
banner.body: Analytics tells us what's working. Error reports help us fix crashes. Your call on both.

dialog.title: Cookies and analytics
dialog.intro: Strictly necessary stuff stays on so the app works. Everything else is up to you.

essential.title: Strictly necessary
essential.body: Login session, language, party session. These stay on so the app works.

analytics.title: Product analytics
analytics.body: We watch which features get used so we know what to build next. Covers PostHog and Vercel Analytics.

errorMonitoring.title: Error monitoring
errorMonitoring.body: Sentry catches crashes with the stack trace and device info we need to reproduce them.

footer.noteOnErrors: Error monitoring kicks in on the next page load.
